name: Line Art Modifier
description: Generate Line Art strokes from selected source

props.name: Use Custom Camera
props.description: Use custom camera instead of the active camera

props.name: Intersection With Contour
props.description: Treat intersection and contour lines as if they were the same type so they can be chained together

props.name: All Lines
props.description: Treat all lines as the same line type so they can be chained together

props.name: Instanced Objects
props.description: Allow particle objects and face/vertex instances to show in Line Art

props.name: Handle Overlapping Edges
props.description: Allow edges in the same location (i.e. from edge split) to show properly. May run slower.

props.name: Clipping Boundaries
props.description: Allow lines generated by the near/far clipping plane to be shown

props.name: Crease Threshold
props.description: Angles smaller than this will be treated as creases. Crease angle priority: object Line Art crease override > mesh auto smooth angle > Line Art default crease.

props.name: Angle Splitting
props.description: Angle in screen space below which a stroke is split in two

props.name: Smooth Tolerance
props.description: Strength of smoothing applied on jagged chains

props.name: Loose As Contour
props.description: Loose edges will have contour type

props.name: Invert Vertex Group
props.description: Invert source vertex group values

props.name: Match Output
props.description: Match output vertex group based on name

props.name: Filter Face Marks
props.description: Filter feature lines using Freestyle face marks

props.name: Invert
props.description: Invert face mark filtering

props.name: Boundaries
props.description: Filter feature lines based on face mark boundaries

props.name: Keep Contour
props.description: Preserve contour lines while filtering

props.name: Image Threshold
props.description: Segments with an image distance smaller than this will be chained together

props.name: Chain Loose Edges
props.description: Allow loose edges to be chained together

props.name: Use Geometry Space
props.description: Use geometry distance for chaining instead of image space

props.name: Preserve Details
props.description: Keep the zig-zag "noise" in initial chaining

props.name: Overlapping Edge Types
props.description: Allow an edge to have multiple overlapping types. This will create a separate stroke for each overlapping type.

props.name: Stroke Depth Offset
props.description: Move strokes slightly towards the camera to avoid clipping while preserve depth for the viewport

props.name: Offset Towards Custom Camera
props.description: Offset strokes towards selected camera instead of the active camera

props.name: Camera Object
props.description: Use specified camera object for generating Line Art strokes

props.name: Light Object
props.description: Use this light object to generate light contour

props.name: Source Type
props.description: Line Art stroke source type

props.name: Object
props.description: Generate strokes from this object

props.name: Collection
props.description: Generate strokes from the objects in this collection

props.name: Use Contour
props.description: Generate strokes from contours lines

props.name: Use Loose
props.description: Generate strokes from loose edges

props.name: Use Crease
props.description: Generate strokes from creased edges

props.name: Use Material
props.description: Generate strokes from borders between materials

props.name: Use Edge Mark
props.description: Generate strokes from Freestyle marked edges

props.name: Use Intersection
props.description: Generate strokes from intersections

props.name: Use Light Contour
props.description: Generate light/shadow separation lines from a reference light object

props.name: Use Shadow
props.description: Project contour lines using a light source object

props.name: Shadow Region Filtering
props.description: Select feature lines that comes from lit or shaded regions. Will not affect cast shadow and light contour since they are at the border.

items.name: None
items.description: Not filtering any lines based on illumination region

items.name: Illuminated
items.description: Only selecting lines from illuminated regions

items.name: Shaded
items.description: Only selecting lines from shaded regions

items.name: Illuminated (Enclosed Shapes)
items.description: Selecting lines from lit regions, and make the combination of contour, light contour and shadow lines into enclosed shapes

props.name: Silhouette Filtering
props.description: Select contour or silhouette

props.name: Fill Strokes
props.description: Generate filled strokes instead of only outline

props.name: Use Occlusion Range
props.description: Generate strokes from a range of occlusion levels

props.name: Level Start
props.description: Minimum number of occlusions for the generated strokes

props.name: Level End
props.description: Maximum number of occlusions for the generated strokes

props.name: Layer
props.description: Grease Pencil layer to which assign the generated strokes

props.name: Material
props.description: Grease Pencil material assigned to the generated strokes

props.name: Source Vertex Group
props.description: Match the beginning of vertex group names from mesh objects, match all when left empty

props.name: Vertex Group
props.description: Vertex group name for selected strokes

props.name: Is Baked
props.description: This modifier has baked data

props.name: Use Cache
props.description: Use cached scene data from the first Line Art modifier in the stack. Certain settings will be unavailable.

props.name: Overscan
props.description: A margin to prevent strokes from ending abruptly at the edge of the image

props.name: Radius
props.description: The radius for the generated strokes

props.name: Opacity
props.description: The strength value for the generate strokes

props.name: Use Material Mask
props.description: Use material masks to filter out occluded strokes

props.name: Match Masks
props.description: Require matching all material masks instead of just one

props.name: Masks
props.description: Mask bits to match from Material Line Art settings

props.name: Match Intersection
props.description: Require matching all intersection masks instead of just one

props.name: Masks
props.description: Mask bits to match from Collection Line Art settings

props.name: Crease On Smooth Surfaces
props.description: Allow crease edges to show inside smooth surfaces

props.name: Crease On Sharp Edges
props.description: Allow crease to show on sharp edges

props.name: Image Boundary Trimming
props.description: Trim all edges right at the boundary of image (including overscan region)

props.name: Back Face Culling
props.description: Remove all back faces to speed up calculation, this will create edges in different occlusion levels than when disabled

props.name: Shadow Camera Near
props.description: Near clipping distance of shadow camera

props.name: Shadow Camera Far
props.description: Far clipping distance of shadow camera

props.name: Shadow Camera Size
props.description: Represents the "Orthographic Scale" of an orthographic camera. If the camera is positioned at the light's location with this scale, it will represent the coverage of the shadow "camera".

props.name: Invert Collection Filtering
props.description: Select everything except lines from specified collection

props.name: Invert Silhouette Filtering
props.description: Select anti-silhouette lines
